## Scoped candidate

The ordinary unnormalized **section-based** Schwarz genus of the nine-flex cover over CP^9 minus the cubic discriminant is **8**, equivalently normalized sectional category **7**. This resolves the curated Chen–Wan 8-versus-9 target relative to the cited lower bound and classical theorem dependencies.

**The literal OWR connected/full-nine-sheet-trivialization requirement is not resolved by this result.** C has flex monodromy of cycle type 1^3 3^2, demonstrating why one section does not trivialize the whole cover; the eight color domains need not be connected.

## Evidence

- Unchanged author proof and one-approach ledger.
- Two independent AI mathematical audits and separate scope-qualified acceptances; no correction required.
- All three pinned safe ZIP archives and external manifests, with the original five author files preserved exactly in the first audit archive.
- Sixteen distinct unpacked authored proof, audit and public-metadata files; no executable proof verifier.
- Static identity, archive safety and acceptance-binding tests pass in normal Python and with `-O`; each rejects 16 corruption/safety controls. These are data-integrity tests, not a mathematical certificate.

Read [the proof, audits and exact scope](https://github.com/AlecKriebel/Math/blob/0e6e23213494ecb4a7208f920d25d7b49502a5cb/unsolved_math_prioritization/attempts/30003711/README.md). Only this problem's Status, Turns and Findings queue cells change, to `claimed_solved`, `1/5`, with the full invariant caveat in the same row. All unrelated queue content and existing chat links are preserved.

The first audit separately records retrieval and inspection of Illman's original article. No copied source PDFs, text extracts, OCR, images, raw datasets, private coordination or private checker fingerprints are included. Historical freeze-time statements are preserved unchanged.

No novelty, priority, conventional human peer review, formal verification, exact algorithmic branching-complexity equality, exhaustive literature search or CI pass is claimed. This is a draft mathematical candidate. 

## Exact-head publication verification

Verified commit `0e6e23213494ecb4a7208f920d25d7b49502a5cb`:

- All **29 changed files** fetched from that exact head and matched against the complete local bytes, byte counts, SHA-256 and Git blob identities.
- All **3 ZIP archives, 3 external manifests and 21 archive members** verified; all unpacked authored files match their archive members. The first audit retains the original five author files byte-for-byte.
- The public package manifest matches all **28 package files** (including itself in the exact inventory check).
- The only existing-file change is this problem's **Status, Turns and Findings** queue cells. All other queue bytes remain unchanged; the same queue base blob is still present on current main `644c5f68990a9c627e14be1317cbb95d4a7a57ff`.
- Static checks and **16 rejection controls** pass again on retrieved remote archives in both normal Python and `-O`. No archive member is executed, and this is not mathematical proof checking.
- The PR is open, draft and unmerged. No check runs, commit statuses or pull-request workflow runs were present at verification time; no CI pass is claimed.

The scoped theorem and unresolved stronger OWR reading remain unchanged.
